disclosures.text: A grip unit for a vacuum hand-operated laying device
A grip unit for use with a suction plate
A housing with a grip portion for gripping the grip unit
An electrically operated vacuum generating device
The grip portion is designed as a hollow body
Exhaust air from the vacuum generating device is guided through the grip portion to an air outlet
A sound-damping device is arranged in the grip portion
A vacuum handling apparatus comprising a suction plate with a carrier plate and a seal fastened to and extending around the carrier plate
A vacuum handling apparatus comprising a grip unit according to claim 1

A grip unit for a vacuum hand-operated laying device and for use with a suction plate, the grip unit comprising: a housing which has a grip portion for gripping the grip unit, and an, electrically operated, vacuum generating device, wherein

A vacuum handling apparatus comprising said suction plate comprising a carrier plate and a seal, which is fastened to the carrier plate and extends around the carrier plate; and said grip unit according to claim 1.
The grip portion is at least partially lined with a sound-damping material
The vacuum generating device is arranged completely in a first housing portion of the housing
A sound-reducing device is arranged in the first housing portion
The first housing portion is lined with sound-reducing material
The grip portion is elongated between the first housing portion and a second housing portion
The air outlet is arranged on the second housing portion
An air collection device, in the form of an air collection screw, is arranged upstream of the grip portion, in the first housing portion, for collecting exhaust air
One or more bent or curved air baffles are arranged downstream of the grip portion, in or in the second housing portion, for guiding exhaust air to the air outlet
A battery coupling point for coupling an electrical energy storage device or a rechargeable battery is arranged on the housing, on the second housing portion
One or more air baffles for directing exhaust air away from the battery coupling point are provided in an region of the air outlet or downstream of the air outlet
The grip unit and the suction plate are releasably connected via a coupling device
The grip unit has a suction opening fluidically connected to a suction chamber delimited by the suction plate to generate a vacuum
